summary: Fourth-year CSE student building full-stack web and real-time applications. Two-time ICPC Dhaka Regional participant, 7th in the 2025 SRBD Code Contest, and a peer instructor in competitive programming.

projects.name: FailureOJ
projects.stack: React, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Python, FastAPI, SymPy, Redis
bullets: Built a bilingual math and science platform with answer submissions, notebook-image uploads, contests, standings, ratings, and learning resources.
Implemented a separate Python/FastAPI judge using SymPy for equivalent numeric expressions and tolerance-based answer checking.
Integrated a Redis-backed retry queue and Socket.IO verdict updates; configured an Android build with Capacitor.

projects.name: FailureChat
bullets: Developed a real-time messaging app with ephemeral messages, group conversations, and editable per-conversation identities.
Integrated Supabase authentication, database access, and real-time updates in a Flutter application.
Taught competitive programming to multiple batches of junior students through regular and camp classes in the university’s senior-to-junior teaching tradition.
Co-founded a platform offering free online programming classes.
